findings.issue: seedDatabaseStructure performs ~11 non-transactional writes after the page.create of a DATABASE page; a mid-seed failure leaves a permanently broken database page
findings.recommendation: Run create + seed in one prisma.$transaction(async tx => ...)

findings.issue: runSave has no in-flight guard and blindly nulls pendingPayloadRef with the older payload — concurrent saves can land out of order and a newer edit typed during a slow save is silently dropped from the server write
findings.recommendation: Serialize saves through a single-flight queue and only clear pendingPayloadRef when it still equals the payload just saved

findings.issue: transferPageAction moves subtree workspaceId and re-parents root in two separate non-transactional updates; failure between leaves children cross-workspace orphaned
createMeetingNoteAction is check-then-create on CalendarEvent.notesPageId with no unique constraint — concurrent calls create two note pages (orphan)
findings.recommendation: Claim via conditional updateMany where notesPageId is null inside a transaction, only create the page when count===1

findings.issue: UNIQUE_ID numbering uses read-then-max at read-committed isolation; concurrent row creations allocate duplicate numbers
findings.recommendation: Use $queryRaw SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on the property row or serializable isolation for the allocation

findings.issue: collab seed registers provider.once('sync') without removing it in cleanup — seeds a destroyed TipTap editor if unmounted mid-sync
Follow-up while streaming: send() lacks a pending guard; second send replaces abortRef and first finally nulls it, making Cancel a no-op
findings.recommendation: Early-return send() when streaming; null abortRef only if it is the same controller

findings.issue: Debounced search has no request token — a stale useTransition result can overwrite newer results
findings.recommendation: Guard setItems with a monotonic request sequence

findings.issue: slug collision loop has no P2002 retry; concurrent signups surface a raw 500 from workspace.create
findings.recommendation: Catch P2002 in signupAction/auth path and regenerate the suffix

findings.issue: moveTicketAction does not verify beforeId ticket's status equals input.status — drop above a row from the wrong column can sort incorrectly
Load more appends without id-dedup or in-flight gate — double-click duplicates the same keyset window
findings.recommendation: Dedup by row id when merging (database-view.tsx:1816 already does)

findings.issue: backup.test.mjs and check-npm-audit.test.mjs fail intermittently in full parallel runs (subprocess/env contention) but pass in isolation — flaky tests
findings.recommendation: Give each subprocess test its own isolated env fixture or serialize them

tests_run: npx vitest run (2/14945 flaky failures, pass in isolation)
